_comment: Real-photo test bank for tools/test_bank.py. Each entry: a photo in this folder, the colors the app SHOULD find (expect_pass) and SHOULD NOT find (expect_fail). Add your grandson's toys here to guard against regressions. The optional source/license/attribution fields document where a photo came from (PD/CC0/CC-BY from Wikimedia Commons); the harness ignores them.
